legend: "I've been here once," Mino exclaims with delight, "it's breathtakingly amazing."
"Look, Kanno, you've got your paintbrush, and I've got my words. Have a try, shall we?"
There are four kinds of flowers in the wood, Amaranths, Begonias, Centaureas and Dianthuses.
The wood can be represented by a rectangular grid of n$$$n$$$ rows and m$$$m$$$ columns. In each cell of the grid, there is exactly one type of flowers.

According to Mino, the numbers of connected components formed by each kind of flowers are a$$$a$$$, b$$$b$$$, c$$$c$$$ and d$$$d$$$ respectively. Two cells are considered in the same connected component if and only if a path exists between them that moves between cells sharing common edges and passes only through cells containing the same flowers.

You are to help Kanno depict such a grid of flowers, with n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ arbitrarily chosen under the constraints given below. It can be shown that at least one solution exists under the constraints of this problem.
Note that you can choose arbitrary n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ under the constraints below, they are not given in the input.
input: The first and only line of input contains four space-separated integers a$$$a$$$, b$$$b$$$, c$$$c$$$ and d$$$d$$$ (1≤a,b,c,d≤100$$$1 \leq a, b, c, d \leq 100$$$) — the required number of connected components of Amaranths, Begonias, Centaureas and Dianthuses, respectively.
output: In the first line, output two space-separated integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (1≤n,m≤50$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 50$$$) — the number of rows and the number of columns in the grid respectively.

Then output n$$$n$$$ lines each consisting of m$$$m$$$ consecutive English letters, representing one row of the grid. Each letter should be among 'A', 'B', 'C' and 'D', representing Amaranths, Begonias, Centaureas and Dianthuses, respectively.
In case there are multiple solutions, print any. You can output each letter in either case (upper or lower).
note: In the first example, each cell of Amaranths, Begonias and Centaureas forms a connected component, while all the Dianthuses form one.

examples.output:
7 7
DDDDDDD
DDDBDBD
DDCDCDD
DBDADBD
DDCDCDD
DBDBDDD
DDDDDDD

legend.ai: “我曾经来过这里，”Mino 兴奋地说道，“美得令人叹为观止。”
“看，Kanno，你有你的画笔，而我有我的文字。试试看，怎么样？”
森林里有四种花：苋属植物、秋海棠属植物、矢车菊属植物和石竹属植物。
这片树林可以用一个 n$$$n$$$ 行 m$$$m$$$ 列的矩形网格表示。网格的每个格子中恰好有一种花。
根据 Mino 的说法，每种花形成的连通分量数量分别为 a$$$a$$$、b$$$b$$$、c$$$c$$$ 和 d$$$d$$$。两个格子被视为属于同一个连通分量，当且仅当它们之间存在一条路径，该路径在共边的格子之间移动，并且只经过含有同一种花的格子。
你需要帮助 Kanno 描绘这样一个花朵网格，其中 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$ 可以在下面给出的约束条件下任意选择。可以证明，在本问题的约束下至少存在一个解。
注意，你可以在下面的约束条件下任意选择 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$，它们不会在输入中给出。

input.ai: 输入的唯一一行包含四个空格分隔的整数 a$$$a$$$、b$$$b$$$、c$$$c$$$ 和 d$$$d$$$(1≤a,b,c,d≤100$$$1 \leq a, b, c, d \leq 100$$$)，分别表示 Amaranths、Begonias、Centaureas 和 Dianthuses 所需的连通分量数量。

output.ai: 在第一行输出两个空格分隔的整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$(1≤n,m≤50$$$1 \leq n, m \leq 50$$$)，分别表示网格的行数和列数。
然后输出 n$$$n$$$ 行，每行由 m$$$m$$$ 个连续的英文字母组成，表示网格的一行。每个字母应为 'A'、'B'、'C' 或 'D'，分别表示苋菜、秋海棠、矢车菊和石竹。
如果有多个解，输出任意一个即可。每个字母可以使用大写或小写。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，苋菜、秋海棠和矢车菊的每个单元格分别构成一个连通块，而所有石竹构成一个连通块。
